senses.gloss:
लिह् लिह्, ii. 2, Par. Ātm. To lick, Hit. i. d. 112, M.M.
 --Ptcple. of the pf. pass. लीढ.
 1. Licked, Kir. 5, 38.
 2. Eaten.
 --Ptcple. of the fut. pass. लेह्य, To be licked, Pañc. 61, 12. n. Food, Ragh. 5, 73. Frequent. लेलिह्, लेलिह्य, To lick repeatedly, MBh. 3, 10394. लेलिह्, Ātm., Chr. 39, 5.
 --Ptcple. of the pres. Ātm. लेलिहान, n.
 1. A snake.
 2. A name of Śiva.
 --With the prep. अव अव,
 1. To lick here and there (figurat.), Lass. 2. ed. 79, 79.
 2. To lick up or off; to eat, Śāk. d. 7.
 3. To touch with the tongue, Man. 4, 203. अवलीढ, Devoured, destroyed, Kirātārj. 13, 11. Frequent. To lick repeatedly, MBh. 1, 1181.
 --With आ आ, To lick, to touch, Ragh. 10, 46. आलिढ,
 1. Eaten.
 2. Polished, Bhartṛ. 2, 36. n. An attitude in shooting, the right knee advanced, the left leg retracted, Kumāras. 3, 70.
 --With प्रत्या प्रति-आ-प्रत्यालीढ, Eaten. n. An attitude in shooting, etc. = आलीढ, n.
 --With परि परि, To lick, to enjoy, Rām. 2, 61, 16. Frequent. To lick repeatedly, Pañc. 55, 7 (see my transl. n. 257).
 --With सम् सम्, To lick, MBh. 3, 10653.
 --With परिसम् परि-सम्, To lick, MBh. 3, 11500.
 --Cf. λείχω, λιχανος, λειχήν; Lat. lingere, pol-lex; Goth. bi-laigôn; A.S. liccian.

ऽलिह् -लिह्, latter part of comp. words, Licking.
 --Comp.
